title: Deployment Strategist, Integration Partnerships
description:
About Rivet
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems - fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking - for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.

Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary

The Deployment Strategist (DS) ensures the successful definition, implementation, and operations of new systems with Rivet customers. The DS guides customer and Rivet collaboration, aligning teams and deployment plans to meet mutual objectives.

The strategist is responsible for analyzing customer conditions, understanding data insights, and developing actionable plans to achieve desired outcomes. Additionally, the DS anticipates potential challenges, devising solutions to mitigate risks - or to achieve win/win competitive advantage.

As a relationship manager, the DS serves as a liaison between technical teams and customer stakeholders, facilitating clear understanding of project goals and progress. The strategist monitors deployment activities, provides regular updates, and ensures fidelity to agreed timelines and milestones. This role favors strong planning skills, acumen for technology breakthroughs with large customers, and a bias toward iterative action. At Rivet, the DS is uniquely positioned to create long-term value with customers trusting us with their most strategic projects.

In addition to deployment execution, the DS plays a key role in shaping new business opportunities. This includes partnering with commercial and technical teams to scope prospective engagements, contribute to technical and programmatic proposals, and translate customer needs into compelling, executable plans. The DS ensures continuity between what is proposed and what is ultimately delivered.

For this particular role, the DS, Integration Partnerships will build and manage a network of technology and industry partners that extends Rivet’s capabilities and accelerates customer outcomes. You will source and triage potential partners, evaluate their technology and strategic fit, develop relationships and integration opportunities, and manage partnerships from initial engagement through deployment and ongoing growth. This role requires strong technical judgment, commercial acumen, and the ability to identify where combining Rivet with complementary technologies can create differentiated solutions and unlock new customer opportunities.

Responsibilities

- Source and develop relationships with technology and industry partners whose capabilities can complement Rivet’s products and create differentiated solutions for customers

- Triage and evaluate prospective partners based on technical capabilities, strategic fit, customer demand, integration complexity, and potential business value

- Work closely with Rivet engineering, product, and commercial teams to define integration opportunities, technical approaches, joint solutions, and paths to

title: Account Executive - Level 1
description:
About Better Impact
Better Impact builds software for organizations that rely on people showing up for one another and their communities.
Our platform helps nonprofits, hospitals, government agencies, volunteer centers, and corporate community programs recruit, onboard, schedule, train, communicate with, and understand the impact of their volunteers. More than 85,000 organizations across 20 countries use Better Impact today. In January 2026, Better Impact and Galaxy Digital combined to create a larger platform dedicated to volunteerism and community engagement.
We are now a team of more than 100 employees and FTEs, operating across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia. We are growing quickly, and our sales team is at the center of that growth.
This is a great moment for the right seller. The mission is strong. The market is large and still under penetrated. Our go-to-market motion is being rebuilt for scale. And there is real quota to win.
About the role
Better Impact is hiring an Account Executive to help carry our next phase of growth. This role will report directly to the VP of Sales.
This is a full-cycle, demo-driven closing role. You will run prospecting, discovery, demo, handle objections, negotiate, and close, primarily with volunteer program leaders at nonprofits, hospitals, government agencies, and volunteer centers.
The company has strong fundamentals: a large market, a proven demo-to-close motion, and leadership that is actively investing in the tools, training, and pricing structure that make it easier for you to win. We need AEs who can execute a proven process at volume today, and who want to grow with a team that is actively getting more disciplined, better resourced, and better enabled as it scales.
You will own your full pipeline: qualifying and running demos on inbound, SDR-sourced, and (increasingly) self-sourced leads, managing forecast and deal hygiene in HubSpot, and closing new business against a defined ACV and deal-volume target. You will work closely with your SDR or BDR team members, your VP of Sales, and Customer Success on handoff and onboarding.
What you will do

• Run a full-cycle sales process from discovery through close: qualify inbound and SDR-set demos, lead a consultative, value-first demo, handle pricing conversations and objections, and close.

• Build roughly 30% of your opportunity pipeline using outbound campaigns that incorporate calling, emailing and social (LinkedIn) strategies

• Carry and hit a monthly quota built on ACV and closed-deal volume, with a clear weekly pipeline review and forecast cadence.

• Build and protect a healthy pipeline, including a self-sourced component through outbound prospecting, sequence follow-up, and reengagement of past closed-lost opportunities.

• Run demos and discovery from the volunteer's point of view first, not just the administrator's, using Better Impact 's established demo methodology and closing checklist.

• Use discovery to surface the prospect's own urgency rather than manufacturing it, and apply approved urgency and pricing frameworks consistently rather than improvising deal-by-deal.

• Keep HubSpot pipeline data accurate and current: deal stage, next steps, decision maker and budget holder, and close date, so your forecast can be trusted.

• Partner with your SDR/BDR and with Customer Success on clean handoffs, so new customers start onboarding with the right expectations and the right contacts.

• Stay current on product, pricing, and competitive positioning as Better Impact modernizes its platform and pricing structure, and bring field feedback back to the team.
Requirements
What you bring

• 2+ years of full-cycle, closing sales experience, ideally in SaaS or software, with a demonstrated track record of hitting or exceeding quota.

• Experience building and running your own outbound sequences (Apollo, Sales Navigator, or similar) alongside inbound demo volume.

• Comfort running a high-volume, demo-driven s

title: Change Business Partner - MRP
description:
Overview
Change Business Partner - MRP
Location: US Remote with travels
Employment: 12 month project based role
Role Overview:
The Change Business Partner will lead the people-side implementation of strategic transformation across manufacturing operations. This includes driving the adoption of new systems, processes, and behaviours that enhance efficiency, safety, and growth. A key focus will be supporting the deployment and behavioural integration of standard costing across manufacturing sites, ensuring consistency in cost control, performance tracking, and margin visibility. The role requires a strong understanding of manufacturing, ERP (notably Microsoft D365), and change facilitation to support both people and site-level transitions.
Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and support change initiatives linked to process improvements and ERP projects, with a particular focus on standard costing.

• Partner with finance, operations, and systems teams to make sure costing methods are understood, applied consistently, and support effective cost control.

• Help operational leaders move from legacy costing approaches to standardised cost models, explaining the impact on reporting, performance measurement, and profitability.

• Work with local teams to build understanding of how standard costs are created and maintained, including bill of materials (BOM) accuracy, labour and machine rates, and overhead allocation.

• Deliver training and capability-building activities that strengthen cost awareness and accountability across production and planning teams.

• Act as the link between Global Process Owners, finance teams, and manufacturing sites, turning costing policy into practical day-to-day processes within D365.

• Support the accuracy and integrity of costing data by identifying gaps in processes, systems, and reporting, and helping teams put the right controls in place.

• Drive adoption of new ways of working, making sure standard costing becomes embedded in decision-making rather than simply a finance exercise.

Qualifications
Requirements:

• Experience delivering change management within an industrial or manufacturing environment.

• Understands and leads for the to-be processes and ways of working.

• Understanding and advocating good practices in principle and in detail for a range of topics especially standard costing (cost build-up, cost drivers, variance analysis, cost updates) and margin management, but also MRP, planning, and warehousing.

• Experience supporting or deploying standard costing frameworks within ERP systems (especially Microsoft D365), including training, data validation, and cost centre alignment.

• Ability to engage both finance and non-finance teams in understanding the operational impact of cost changes, cost performance, and product profitability.

• Proven ability to build relationships and influence frontline teams, middle management, and senior leaders.

• Strong communication and facilitation skills, particularly in operational and technical contexts.

• Experience with ERP systems (JD Edwards, Microsoft D365) is a strong advantage.

• Comfortable working at different levels of the organisation.

• Flexible to adapt to the changing business needs of the projects.

• Serves as best practice/quality resource within Standard costing and ERP Transformations.

Qualifications and Behaviours:

• Aptitude to learn and adapt, seeing change opportunities and encouraging others to seek positive change.

• Change Management or Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher) is an advantage.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in finance management or transformation, or multi-site general management roles within manufacturing or industrial sectors.

CDI is growing quickly. In 2025, our team doubled in size to 30 employees, and we expect to grow to 50 within the next year. As the organization grows, we want to ensure our people practices, systems, and culture grow with it.
We are looking for a Director of People Operations with strong HR generalist foundations and experience supporting organizations through rapid growth and increasing complexity. This role includes managing and supporting a People Operations Generalist who leads CDI’s talent acquisition work and supports broader people operations processes. • Lead initiatives that strengthen CDI’s culture and employee experience, including onboarding, trainings, team gatherings, and org-wide rituals

• Build and evolve the systems, feedback channels, and people practices that help CDI maintain a strong, connected, and mission-driven culture as we scale

• Lead all-hands meetings and internal communications that build clarity, alignment, and connection across the organization

Manager Support & Employee Development

• Evaluate and manage HR vendors, benefits brokers, and external service providers

title: Staff Engineer, iOS
description:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:
Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.
At AlphaSense , we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.
About the Role:
AlphaSense has spent more than a decade helping professionals find, trust, and synthesize market intelligence. With SuperAnalyst, we are expanding that foundation into continuous, decision-ready execution: workflows that monitor change, update outputs, and surface what matters as situations evolve. Mobile is a critical part of that future because the moments that matter do not only happen when customers are sitting at a desktop.
iOS is an important surface for that future because continuous, decision-ready workflows need to feel fast, secure, polished, and reliable across iPhone, iPad, and managed enterprise environments.
As a Staff iOS Engineer, you will own and evolve the iOS architecture and mobile-facing foundations that shape product quality across customer workflows. You will work from deep iOS expertise while shaping the technical decisions, validation practices, and delivery patterns that help teams build reliable native experiences with confidence.
This is a hands-on Staff role with significant architectural ownership, platform-level leverage, and long-term product impact. You will help teams move faster while improving delivery predictability and preserving the quality, reliability, and trust that enterprise mobile experiences require, including by shaping the AI-enabled development, validation, and testing practices that make iOS delivery safer and more confident.
What You’ll Do:

•
Own and evolve the iOS platform foundation: Define the iOS architecture, modular boundaries, and native engineering patterns that make AlphaSense experiences fast, reliable, secure, and easier to evolve as the product grows.

•
Lead through hands-on iOS system design: Turn complex product and platform problems into durable production architecture grounded in deep iOS expertise and modern Apple platform practices.

•

Experience with GraphQL or WebSocket integrations alongside standard REST protocols.

Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant) or AI/LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) for AI-integrated backends.

Experience migrating legacy Django or Flask monolithic architectures to decoupled FastAPI microservices.

Design, build, and document secure, high-concurrency microservices and RESTful endpoints using FastAPI and OpenAPI/Swagger standards.

Profile asynchronous bottlenecks, manage event loops, optimize database queries, and scale caching layers to maintain sub-millisecond response times under peak load.

title: Staff Product Manager: Agentic Discovery
description:
Staff Product Manager, Agentic Discovery

About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary We're looking for a systems-minded, AI-native Staff Product Manager to help lead the next chapter of Constructor: Agentic Discovery. As commerce shifts toward agentic experiences, we're investing heavily in a portfolio of AI-powered surfaces - our AI Shopping Assistant, Product Insights Agent, Prism recommendations, and more to come - that change how shoppers discover products and how businesses run discovery.

This is a high-leverage, high-ambiguity role. You'll own two things at once: helping our agentic experiences scale from promising experiments into a repeatable, reliable engine, and giving the business teams who depend on them the same transparency and control over agentic experiences that they have today over traditional search.

You'll start by owning the business tooling and dashboards for agentic discovery - the experiences that let business teams see what our agents are doing, why, and to what effect, so they can execute faster and steer with confidence. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Agentic Discovery chapter: the on-site agentic experiences, the offsite/agentic surfaces, the integrations that connect them, and the agentic tooling underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Agentic discovery at Constructor is fundamentally an AI and machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes it. You'll partner closely with ML, engineering, design, and go-to-market to turn new agentic capabilities into experiences that ship, prove value, and stay under our customers' control - and serve as the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams behind one coherent vision for agentic discovery.

If you're excited about defining a brand-new category, being held to real usage and business outcomes, and giving businesses control over the AI experiences shaping their storefronts, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

- Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in usage and business outcomes - conversion, revenue, engagement - across Constructor's agentic experiences.

- Give businesses transparency and control. Build the dashboards and tooling that let business teams see what agentic experiences are doing, understand why, and steer them - closing the gap to the control they have in traditional search.

- Scale experimentation. Turn one-off agentic experiments into a repeatable, scalable way to launch, measure, and improve new agentic interfaces - cutting time-to-launch.

- Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for Agentic Discovery - where we're heading and why - tie it to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

- Lead the business-tooling and dashboard experience first. Own its strategy and roadmap, and make agentic behavior and impact visible and actionable for business users.

 

- Orchestrate across surfaces. Unite on-site agentic experiences, offsite/agentic surfaces, and integrations behind one definition of agentic disc

title: Senior Engineer, DevOps

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, or SRE roles, with production experience in both AWS and GCP.

• Strong background with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform preferred) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).

• Experience with CI/CD tooling and modern DevOps automation practices.

title: Senior Manager Information Security
description:
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 17 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.

The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 40,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.

Tabby generates over $10 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.

Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $4.5 billion.

We are looking for a Senior Manager Information Security to lead and shape Tabby ’s information security function across both strategic and technical domains. This role will lead a team of security professionals and own key security programmes across cloud security, security architecture, application security, vulnerability management, threat detection and incident response.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and contribute hands-on to security architecture and technical security reviews across cloud, infrastructure and product initiatives.

• Design and implement security controls across GCP and AWS , including IAM, CSPM and cloud-native security.

• Drive and contribute to Secure SDLC / DevSecOps , including SAST, DAST, SCA and container security.

• Lead vulnerability management and actively participate in penetration testing, VAPT and red/purple team engagements.

• Design and improve threat detection, SIEM use cases and security monitoring.

• Lead and participate in complex security incident investigations and response.

• Drive endpoint, infrastructure, network and firewall security initiatives.

• Automate security processes and develop security tooling where needed.

• Establish technical standards, security best practices and operating procedures.

• Manage, mentor and develop a team of security engineers and analysts.

• Work closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, IT, Legal and Compliance teams to embed security across Tabby .

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• Strong experience leading Information Security / Cyber Security functions in a senior technical or management role.

•
5+ years of experience in Information Security or Cybersecurity, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership or senior individual contributor role. Prior people management or team leadership experience is strongly preferred.

• Deep expertise across Cloud Security, Security Architecture, VAPT, AppSec/DevSecOps and Defensive Security .

• Experience leading security programmes and managing cross-functional initiatives.

• Strong knowledge of GCP/AWS, IAM, CSPM, SIEM, EDR/XDR and vulnerability management .

• Strong understanding of penetration testing, red/purple teaming, threat hunting and incident response .

• Experience with SAST, DAST, SCA and container security within CI/CD environments.

• Strong understanding of security architecture, threat modelling and enterprise security controls.

• Experience working within a regulated FinTech or banking environment .

• Knowledge of CBUAE, UAE PDPL, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001 and SOC 2 .

• Proven people leadership, stakeholder management and strategic decision-making skills.

•
CISSP/CISM and OSCP or equivalent certifications are preferred/required depending on the final hiring criteria.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

description:
The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time-but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on. At Overstory , we’re harnessing cutting-edge technology to enable a resilient electrical grid that keeps communities thriving as our world changes.

The grid is the backbone of life as we know it. It powers hospitals, keeps food fresh, and ensures communities stay connected. But extreme weather, aging infrastructure, and growing wildfire risks are putting this critical system under pressure. All of this combined makes the electric utility industry the greatest opportunity for tackling climate change.

One of the leading causes of catastrophic wildfires and power outages? Trees and brush coming into contact with power lines.

That’s where we help. At Overstory , we use AI and advanced satellite imagery to pinpoint and prioritize vegetation risks before they materialize. By giving utilities critical analysis on those risks, we’re helping prevent outages, reduce wildfire risks, and accelerate the transition to a safer, more resilient grid.

Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We’re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to climate action, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.

Join us to help us build a more resilient world together.

Role & Team
As a Staff Data Engineer at Overstory , you will lead the design and scaling of the data platform that enables Overstory ’s AI-powered vegetation analysis. Our analysis depends on moving enormous volumes of satellite imagery, model inferences, and utility network data through orchestrated pipelines reliably, repeatably, and on time to support customer decision-making. You'll own the architecture of that platform and set the direction for how it evolves.
You'll work closely with data, ML, and product engineers, as well as product teams, to make sure the data flowing into our models and out to our customers balances pragmatic delivery with durability, traceability, and scalability. As a senior technical leader, you'll mentor other engineers, drive architectural decisions, and set standards for pipeline design, service boundaries, and data quality across Overstory .
Time zone requirement: Europe (GMT/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST)
What You'll Do
In collaboration with data, ML, and product colleagues, you will:

• Architect and evolve our orchestration layer - asset graphs, quality checks, partitioning strategies, and the patterns that keep it scaling reliably.

• Design and maintain production data pipelines for large-scale geospatial and temporal data, from ingestion through transformation to delivery.

• Lead system design work across the data platform, including service boundaries, data contracts, and designing around the failure modes that come with each.

• Drive the shift toward a service-oriented architecture, decoupling tightly bound components into services that teams can own and deploy independently.

• Build event-driven workflows, replacing brittle coupling and manual coordination with durable messaging patterns.

• Establish observability, testing, and data quality frameworks so problems surface before customers see them, allowing any result to be traced back and explained.

• Mentor engineers and define the standards for how we build, test, and operate data systems.

Skills & Experience

• Experience thriving at the intersection of data engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale scientific data; deeply motivated by the opportunity to reduce wildfire risk and improve grid resilience through better data patterns and infrastructure

• 10+ years of experience designing and building production-grade data pipelines and systems

• Deep hands-on experience with Dagster - asset-based orchestration, partition

title: Senior Optical Network Engineer II
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at  www.coreweave.com .

 

We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

What You'll Do:

We are building a global optical backbone designed to support infrastructure at massive scale. We are looking for experienced Optical Network Engineers to help design, build, operate, and evolve the optical network that underpins our global IP backbone.

This is a senior engineering role for engineers with deep, hands-on experience designing and operating production optical networks. You will work across the complete optical lifecycle, from dark fiber and photonic engineering through DWDM system design, deployment, capacity expansion, automation, monitoring, and production operations.

You will work closely with IP Backbone Engineering and Network Architecture to ensure that the optical and IP layers are designed together to provide predictable capacity, physical diversity, failure isolation, and resiliency.

We are specifically looking for engineers who understand the underlying optical network, not just how to configure individual platforms.

About the role:

You will help design, build, and operate our global optical backbone.

You will:

• Design, engineer and operate long-haul, metro, and data-center interconnect optical networks.

• Engineer DWDM systems across dark-fiber infrastructure.

• Design optical paths including amplification, regeneration, wavelength planning, spectrum allocation, and optical power budgets.

• Engineer and operate C-band and L-band optical systems.

• Deploy, configure, operate, and troubleshoot Nokia, Ciena and other optical platforms.

• Commission new fiber spans, wavelengths, and optical systems.

• Perform fiber characterization and validate new dark-fiber routes before production deployment.

• Analyze span loss, connector loss, reflectance, dispersion, OSNR, Q-factor/Q-margin, BER, and other optical performance characteristics.

• Troubleshoot complex optical impairments and fiber-related issues using platform telemetry and appropriate optical test equipment.

• Design amplifier chains and understand EDFA and Raman amplification requirements.

• Engineer coherent optical transmission across metro and long-haul networks.

Full-time contractor · Fully remote

Cloudnonic is an international, fully remote cloud and software company. We build customized cloud-native systems for clients in Europe and North America, and we're looking for a Semi-Senior backend developer to join the team.

Who we are

Cloudnonic Corp . is a digitally native software and cloud startup based in the Kitchener/Waterloo area, Ontario, Canada. We're fully remote, with developers in Canada and South America and clients across Europe, North America, and South America. We work across healthcare, finance, construction, and manufacturing, and we take the time to understand each client's industry so we can serve it well with technology.

We're big on AI and the cloud. Our services range from app and web development to AI and cloud integration, plus technology consulting: designing feasible, secure, cost-effective architectures for non-technical clients and advising them on their tech stack.

The role

You'll join a healthcare project built in Node.js with Nest.js. You'll work with a wide range of code, libraries, and technologies, review other developers' code, and build the kind of adaptability that comes from switching between technologies rather than staying in one repository.

We deliver AI-first. AI generates our tickets and acceptance criteria, we pair with AI while developing, and every pull request goes through AI review before a senior engineer reviews it. That makes us fast. It also means we have no room for developers who can only prompt. You need to be able to read what the AI produced, know when it's wrong, and fix it yourself: solid fundamentals in JavaScript, Node.js, data structures, HTTP, and databases are the baseline, not a bonus. If you can't explain your code without the tool that wrote it, this isn't the role for you. Part of our technical interview is done without AI assistance.

You'll work directly with the client to architect solutions, and you'll be in direct contact with clients to discuss new features and present your progress. You'll learn to present ideas to clients in a professional, friendly way. Expect to be challenged constantly, and to enjoy the work along the way.

What you'll do

title: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) - Somerville, MA
description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

description:

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Territory Sales Manager (TSM) is responsible for developing, cultivating and driving strong sales partnerships with Distributors and End Users in our Central region. Come build your future with us!

• Ability to work independently and handle multiple projects simultaneously

• Flexible and adaptable to change and ability to work in a fast paced environment

• Ability to influence and drive approval from various stakeholders at all levels

• Prior CRM usage and experience, SalesForce.com

Bask & Lather Co. is a fast-growing, family-founded textured haircare brand built on a scalp-first philosophy, authentic results, and a deeply engaged community. We are seeking a hands-on Senior CRM Manager to own the execution and performance of our customer relationship marketing program. Q4 execution is an immediate priority, alongside building a durable lifecycle program.

Campaign Strategy and Q4 Execution

• Own the email and SMS calendar for launches, education, promotions, replenishment, and engagement.

• Translate business priorities into briefs, audience plans, creative requirements, send schedules, and measurable goals.

• Lead Black Friday/Cyber Monday and holiday CRM planning, including offers, segmentation, contact frequency, contingency plans, and recaps.

• Partner with Brand, Creative, E-Commerce, Growth, Product, and CX to deliver timely, accurate messages.

• Establish pre-send QA for audience, consent, suppression, offer, inventory, links, rendering, timing, and tracking.

• Coordinate email, SMS, and relevant app messaging so the customer experience remains coherent.

Klaviyo, Data, and Operations

• Help complete and stabilize the email and SMS migration to Klaviyo. Validate customer data, consent and suppressions, event tracking, flows, integrations, and deliverability before and after cutover.

• Partner with E-Commerce and technical resources on Shopify, subscription, and other customer events.

• Create documentation, naming conventions, approval workflows, and repeatable QA checklists.

• Protect list health, deliverability, and customer preferences while operating an ambitious calendar.

Measurement and Leadership

• Own weekly CRM reporting across campaign and flow results, customer cohorts, repeat purchase, subscription behavior, list health, and testing insights.

• Build a prioritized test plan for audiences, content, timing, offers, and journeys. Use baselines and holdouts where feasible to assess incremental impact.

• Manage, coach, and set priorities for the CRM Coordinator. Review work and build technical and analytical skills.

• Manage agency or freelance support when needed and flag capacity, data, creative, or launch risks early.

title: Program Manager, Vendor Service Delivery Lead
description:

Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Driver Understanding Software Quality & Experiences Operations team (DUSQE Ops) is at the heart of ensuring the safety, reliability, and quality of the Waymo Driver. The Vendor Service Delivery & Strategy team within DUSQE Ops owns vendor delivery and performance management at scale and drives continuous improvements in vendor performance and business outcomes.

As a Vendor Service Delivery Program Manager, you will be responsible for a portfolio of vendor service delivery programs that span across multiple functional / technical areas in the operations domain.

You will:

• Drive outcomes for large and complex vendor delivery programs that span multiple functions. Set up short/long term goals and priorities and drive delivery on projects and OKRs.

You have:

• Bachelor's degree in business, or technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• 10+ years of experience and proven ability to manage complex, tech-enabled operations and work across cross-functional  partners to drive outcomes.

• Experience directing multiple scaled vendor supported operations running concurrently.

• Experience building and leading forecasting, workforce and budget planning, and plan-to-actuals spend monitoring processes for scaled operations.

• Willingness and flexibility to work non-standard hours, as required, to collaborate with teams based in US and other regions.

• Ability to thrive in a high ambiguity, dynamic environment.

 

We prefer:

• Experience working with fast-paced emerging technologies. Experience in SWQ / AI / Data Operations is a plus.

• Experience scaling vendor operations and bringing immature operations to maturity.

• Strong data analysis and technical skills; ability to work with Engineers across multiple disciplines.

• Proficiency in SQL and data visualization and using it to identify root causes of operational bottlenecks.

• Experience working in a multi-geography environment with US based teams.

title: Pricing Expert
locationText: Argentina, Colombia, Costa Rica, Mexico, Peru, Uruguay, Venezuela
description:
¡Hola! Somos Cashea 👋 y nuestra misión es devolverle a los venezolanos la oportunidad de acceder al crédito a través de un modelo de negocios BNPL. Desde nuestro lanzamiento en 2022, nos hemos dedicado a promover la inclusión financiera. Hoy día tenemos más de 9 millones de usuarios activos, tanto para consumidores como para comercios, y nos hemos convertido en una marca de confianza en Venezuela, conquistando mentes y corazones
Resumen del rol
Buscamos un Pricing Expert con experiencia en Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) para liderar el diseño, implementación y evolución de la estrategia de pricing de los productos de Cashea . Será responsable de desarrollar modelos de pricing que integren costos, riesgo, impuestos, condiciones de mercado, benchmark de competencia y objetivos comerciales para definir estructuras de precio rentables, competitivas y comercialmente viables.
Este rol trabajará de manera transversal con Comercial, Credit Assessment, Finanzas, Impuestos, Producto, Data y Engineering para asegurar que las decisiones de pricing maximicen el crecimiento del negocio, la rentabilidad del portafolio y la competitividad de la oferta.
Responsabilidades

• Diseñar y administrar el modelo integral de pricing para los productos BNPL, incluyendo tasas, comisiones, descuentos, plazos y estructuras de cobro.

• Desarrollar modelos financieros que incorporen costo de fondeo, pérdida esperada, costos operativos, impuestos, márgenes objetivo y variables de riesgo.

• Construir escenarios y simulaciones para evaluar el impacto del pricing en rentabilidad, volumen, competitividad y resultados financieros.

• Diseñar frameworks de pricing basados en valor, políticas de descuentos, arquitecturas de precios y reglas para pricing dinámico.

• Monitorear el mercado y realizar benchmarking continuo para identificar oportunidades de mejora y mantener la competitividad de la oferta.

• Desarrollar modelos analíticos que soporten las decisiones de pricing, incluyendo elasticidad de demanda, simuladores de rentabilidad, análisis de sensibilidad y herramientas de monitoreo competitivo.

• Consolidar los diferentes inputs del negocio en propuestas de pricing alineadas con los objetivos financieros, comerciales y de riesgo.

• Actuar como referente técnico de pricing para las áreas de Comercial, Riesgo, Finanzas, Producto e Impuestos, apoyando negociaciones, lanzamientos y decisiones estratégicas.

• Monitorear el desempeño real del portafolio versus las proyecciones del modelo, identificando desviaciones e impulsando mejoras continuas.

• Colaborar con Data, Engineering y Finanzas para automatizar los modelos de pricing e integrarlos en los procesos y sistemas de originación.

Requisitos

• Más de 4 años de experiencia en Pricing dentro de BNPL, banca de consumo, fintech de crédito o industrias afines.

• Experiencia comprobada desarrollando modelos de pricing y rentabilidad para productos financieros o de crédito.

• Sólido conocimiento de conceptos como costo de fondeo, merchant discount rate, APR, pérdida esperada, márgenes y estructuras de comisiones.

• Dominio avanzado de Excel (u otras herramientas AI) para modelado financiero y análisis de escenarios.

• Experiencia trabajando de forma transversal con equipos de Comercial, Riesgo, Finanzas e Impuestos.

• Alta capacidad analítica, orientación al negocio y habilidades de comunicación para traducir análisis complejos en recomendaciones accionables.

Deseable

• Experiencia específica en BNPL tradicional.

• Conocimientos en scoring crediticio, provisiones y gestión de riesgo de portafolio.

• Manejo de Python y/o SQL para análisis de datos y automatización de modelos.

• Experiencia presentando análisis y recomendaciones a audiencias ejecutivas y no técnicas.

• Inglés avanzado.

En Cashea tenemos una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y el propósito. Si necesitas una pista de por qué somos una buena opción, estos son nuestros valores fundamentales:
